title: Bounded Pipeline Reform & Hardening Alignment
goals: G-1 Add proof-target identity as an orthogonal axis to REAL-DATA without weakening it
G-2 Surface authority divergence structurally and close cutovers as chains
G-3 Make temporary custody itemized and never destructive by inference
G-4 Land every change through the bounded pipeline itself, post-finalize, with grandfathering
non_goals: No automatic product deployment or live-money action
No replacement for mapcodebase architecture surfaces
No requirement that every unit test start services
No ban on fixtures for narrow unit/BVA work
No auto-deletion of branches, worktrees, or releases
No universal ledger for unrelated user-owned checkouts
No claim that these gates would certainly have prevented history

operator_decisions.OQ-1: expected target fields join tmr_record_hash (keystone 2b projection changes)
operator_decisions.OQ-2: transient tool-turn subagent workspaces exempt from custody rows
operator_decisions.OQ-3: D-2 guardrail alignment (TCOV -> ORACLE with executable witness) in scope
operator_decisions.OQ-4: Fizzy validates plan schema + metadata contracts only; TMR execution logic stays in skill/runner
operator_decisions.OQ-5: enforcement fence: pipeline_version 5 warning mode, pipeline_version 6 hard reject
operator_decisions.OQ-6: debate quorum: codex seat + gemini seat (cross-vendor)
operator_decisions.RB-1: Enforcement anchored on card created_at >= cutover_timestamp AND pipeline_version >= 6; cards created before cutover are grandfathered
operator_decisions.OQ-7: 24-hour receipt freshness window; invalidated immediately if the underlying target ref/hash changes
operator_decisions.OQ-8: 100% quorum consensus: both critic families must flag the seeded wrong-route violation

user_stories.title: Bootstrap verifies the hardening toolchain
user_stories.story: As a new maintainer, I want documented prerequisites, one readiness command reporting ready/degraded/broken with named remediation, and a worked non-money example, so that I complete my first useful obligation without reconstructing the toolchain.

user_stories.title: Target-bound test obligations
user_stories.story: As a conductor, I want a triggered TMR to carry a target_binding so that a passing test cannot discharge an obligation via a sibling route, harness caller, or predecessor authority.

user_stories.title: Progressive binding population
user_stories.story: As a conductor, I want binding fields to populate across the maturity ladder so that Phase 2 authoring is not blocked by fifteen mandatory fields.

user_stories.title: Triggered authority census
user_stories.story: As a conductor in Phase 4, I want the structural trigger to demand authority-paths.json with every outcome-equivalent path so that a failing-path-plus-one-sibling review cannot leave live routes unverified.

user_stories.title: Cutover chains in execution planning
user_stories.story: As a conductor in Phase 7, I want every role-changing path expanded into a cutover chain with not_applicable(reason) allowed so that source commits and process launches cannot close independently.

user_stories.title: Observed target at promotion
user_stories.story: As the Phase 8 skill-runner, I want run evidence to carry a runner-produced target_observation compared against the binding with typed rejects so that a real run of the wrong thing is a reject, not a pass.

user_stories.title: Typed fixture provenance
user_stories.story: As a conductor, I want boundary substitutions declared by type and the lexical mock scan demoted to advisory so that makeEnvelope cannot pass and 'no mocks' prose cannot halt.

user_stories.title: Custody ledger
user_stories.story: As an operator, I want every durable pipeline-owned temporary authority to have one ledger row, a budget that blocks creation but never authorizes cleanup, and an itemized preview before any removal so that a worktree contraction can never be closed by count.

user_stories.title: Critic and adversary prompts
user_stories.story: As a conductor, I want debate guardrails and gauntlet seats asked about retired/emergency/non-product paths, shared contracts, identity contradictions, and callable predecessors so that existing seats attack route identity with no new model launch.

user_stories.title: Finalize binding and ORACLE alignment
user_stories.story: As a conductor in Phase 6, I want TCOV repointed to ORACLE with an executable witness, failing a triggered test without binding and refusing concern closure without a named enforcing test plus proof target.

user_stories.title: Golden replay and mutation proof
user_stories.story: As a worker, I want the 18 golden cases to replay with their expected codes, the three controls to stay accepted, and every binding field to have a mutation test producing its specific code.

user_stories.title: Rollout and grandfathering
user_stories.story: As an operator, I want warning mode on pipeline_version 5, hard rejects on version 6, legacy TMRs visibly legacy-unbound, and skill edits shipped as Phase 7 W-tasks post-finalize.

user_stories.title: Dogfood on the v6 bounded pipeline
user_stories.story: As the conductor of this session, I want the session to run D0 decomposition, per-leaf A->S, and fan-in gauntlet, recording every process failure it hits.

user_stories.title: Recovery after a rejected proof
user_stories.story: As a blocked worker, I want every rejection to name the failed expectation, expected vs observed, whether evidence is missing or mismatched, and the next actor and permitted recovery, so that I can recover without discarding unrelated completed work.

user_stories.title: Reconciliation after interruption
user_stories.story: As an operator returning after an interrupted run or custody operation, I want incomplete runs and surviving temporary resources reconciled before dependent work proceeds, so that interruption can never imply completion or exemption.

user_stories.title: Integration ownership
user_stories.story: As an integration maintainer of the keystone, the skill, or the Fizzy consumer, I want explicit compatibility and validation ownership per contract, so that producers and consumers agree without duplicating each other's responsibilities.

user_stories.title: Downstream adoption
user_stories.story: As a downstream maintainer (prediction-prime first), I want an adoption guide, a v5 to v6 migration path, and an ordinary-work control example, so that I can introduce the reform without new requirements on unaffected work.

architecture_impact.rationale: Adds a shared typed reject-code catalog and a runner-owned target-observation collector consumed across promotion, plan self-check, finalize ORACLE, and custody close; adds two new durable artifacts (authority-paths.json, custody-ledger.jsonl) and extends the TMR keystone. Validators are pure functions inside existing component classes; the cross-cutting catalog and collector are the new shared surfaces, so Phase 4 runs in full mode.

new_middleware.purpose: capture caller/path/authority/contract hashes/PID+start time at run time; owner cannot author it

new_vars_into_existing_middleware.purpose: declare the subject an obligation discharges; expected fields join tmr_record_hash (OQ-1)
observed identity compared against binding at promotion
typed ceiling replaces lexical mock scan

self_hosting_rule: This session finalizes using only gates that exist today. Every new gate (ORACLE alignment, target-binding checks, census, custody) is delivered by this session's Phase 7/8 W-tasks and exercised end-to-end by the next v6 session (US-12/US-16). No closed phase is reopened to manufacture compliance.

release_blockers.text: OQ-5 (version-only fence: v5 warn, v6 reject) conflicts with US-11 (in-flight work never retroactively failed) for cards already at pipeline_version 6 when enforcement lands. Operator must approve a rollout schedule or amend the policy before enforcement is exposed. No silent downgrade or hidden selector.
